title: NYU-VPR: Long-Term Visual Place Recognition Benchmark with View Direction and Data Anonymization Influences
reasoning: The paper addresses the ethical concern of data privacy by studying the effect of data anonymization on VPR performance. However, its core contribution is a technical benchmark for computer vision algorithms, not an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical principles themselves.
